name: MyOS Agent Operation Mandate
description:
Reusable Operation Mandate allowing one MyOS Agent Actor to invoke the
inherited operation for matching target documents on behalf of one MyOS
Principal Actor. Version 1 requires deterministic static document scope.

The optional ordered rules list contains owner-readable instructions for a
constrained MyOS intelligent evaluator. Rules may only narrow the
deterministic document and request scope. The feeder never interprets rule
text or invokes a model.

rules.description:
Optional ordered immutable rules. An absent or empty list means that no
intelligent evaluation is required. Rule IDs must be non-blank and unique
within the exact mandate state; the MyOS host enforces those constraints.

id.description: Stable unique rule identifier within this exact mandate state.

text.description: Owner-readable instruction evaluated for each candidate action.
